metadata.note: SYNTHETIC SAMPLE DATA for hackathon demo purposes. Structure mirrors intended production inputs (historical baselines blended with live satellite/weather feeds). Replace `generate.py`'s synthetic series with live ingestion before production use.

units.temp_anomaly_c: deviation from seasonal average temperature, Celsius
units.water_point_level_pct: percent capacity of primary water source
units.grazing_capacity_pct: estimated percent of normal grazing capacity remaining
units.feed_days_remaining: estimated days of feed/grazing remaining at current herd size
units.estimated_financial_impact_zar: illustrative cumulative cost estimate, South African Rand

data_sources.historical_baseline: 10-year seasonal norms per farm location (rainfall, NDVI, temperature)
data_sources.live_weather_feeds: SAWS (South African Weather Service) + DWS hydrological data
data_sources.farm_level_inputs: farmer-submitted herd size, water-point locations, grazing-camp boundaries
data_sources.ingestion_note: Live feeds should be pulled on a scheduled job and appended to the same schema below, keyed by farm_id and week_start, so the dashboard always reads from one continuously updated store.
